finalText:
I've put Dana's new address on her order that hadn't shipped, and her order already in transit is unchanged.

- **O-1001 (not shipped yet):** The address changed from 12 Alder Lane, Bristol BS1 4TR, UK to **7 Quarry Rise, Sheffield S11 8XZ, UK**. Both items on it (1 × P-KEY and 2 × P-CAB) are still waiting to ship, so they'll go to the new address.
- **O-1002 (in transit):** It shipped on 2026-07-07 and still shows 88 Old Mill Road, Bristol BS3 2QQ, UK. I checked it again after the change and nothing on it moved: same status, same address, no refunds. The store's rules don't allow changing the address on a shipped order, so this parcel will arrive at that Bristol address.

One thing you may want to check: her two orders had different old addresses (12 Alder Lane and 88 Old Mill Road). This didn't affect what I did, but it's worth knowing which one she actually lived at. If 88 Old Mill Road isn't hers, she may need help getting that parcel back.
